body:
Goal: Review tests for slugify.py once Engineer finishes T1.
Task: T2 will become ready after T1 is done.
Instructions:
- When T1 is done, read tests/test_slugify.py and slugify.py.
- Run the tests yourself: hermes-crew verify python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
- Decide whether tests are meaningful (asserting behaviour, not just calling functions).
- Approve tests/test_slugify.py using 'hermes-crew board approve tests/test_slugify.py "<what was checked>"', or send Engineer a short list of fixes.
- When approved and verified, mark task done: hermes-crew task done T2
